snippet.title: [BETA] Zaos - Teaser 1
snippet.description:
Zaos is a free-to-play fantasy MMORPG where everyone plays in one shared world. Chat is translated live into your language, so players from nine languages adventure, trade and fight side by side.

Face bosses driven by tactical AI: they read the battlefield, choose their attacks and change phase mid-fight, and their ground warnings show exactly where the hit will land. Take to the sky on flying mounts, choose one of four classes and eight paths, and fight your way to level 90 through regions where every one is a new chapter of the story.

Dungeons in three difficulties, guilds with their own land, guild wars, a monthly Battle Pass and PvP from the arena to the lawless zone. Power is earned in play, never bought.

Closed Beta starts 13 November.

Subscribe for trailers, gameplay and development updates.
